## Purpose

This repository maintains the versioned scientific contract and catalog used to acquire, quality-control, harmonize, derive, certify, and reuse environmental data across the Humboldt Current System.

The heavy data themselves are stored outside GitHub. This repository contains only the auditable definitions, lightweight catalogs, provenance records, quality-control decisions, and orchestration code required to reconstruct and reuse certified products.

## Architecture

```text
providers
  ↓
external cin/raw
  ↓
frozen config + oceancube
  ↓
external cin/interim / cin/processed
  ↓
QC + provenance gates
  ↓
versioned catalog
  ↓
downstream scientific repositories
```

See [`docs/architecture.md`](docs/architecture.md) for the separation between `oceancube`, this workflow, the external data store, and paper-specific repositories.

## Workflow status

The repository is currently at **development release 0.1.0**. Infrastructure and governance are established, but the HCS master domain and provider product IDs remain intentionally unfrozen.

No bulk acquisition should begin until:

1. the master domain receives a documented `GO` decision;
2. the first environmental family has a frozen provider/product/version contract;
3. catalog and QC validation pass automatically.

## Processing sequence

1. Data governance contract
2. Geographic domain
3. Product registry
4. Acquisition
5. Raw source QC
6. Standardization
7. Derived variables
8. Climatology / anomalies when justified
9. Catalog and provenance certification
10. Reuse validation

Each stage terminates in `GO`, `REVIEW`, or `STOP` before downstream propagation.

## Data catalog

The lightweight catalog is maintained under `catalog/`. Its schemas are versioned under `metadata/schemas/`; the relationship between scientific configuration and certified catalog records is defined in [`docs/catalog-contract.md`](docs/catalog-contract.md).
